summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with its operational review for the year ended 30 June 2026. The report highlights record iron ore and ~2 Mt copper production, disciplined cost performance, and a strengthened growth pipeline. It discusses progress on copper growth options, including the Cerro Colorado restart, development pathways for Copper South Australia, Escondida, and Spence, and US copper options through Resolution and Faraday. Vicuña received RIGI approval, and Jansen potash is on track. The filing is a routine business update and does not trigger a special-situations category.
